title: Cognitive tasks

turns.speaker: Guest Speaker 1
turns.text: All creatures, even viruses, live in a world, in a spatial world. And they need to move toward things that will sustain them

turns.speaker: Guest Speaker 1
turns.text: away from things that will hound them. So the basic decision that even viruses have to make

turns.speaker: Guest Speaker 1
turns.text: what to approach and what to avoid. And that basic decision is a decision about acting in space.

turns.speaker: Guest Speaker 1
turns.text: it comes with emotion. There are positive emotions towards things that will sustain us and negative emotions, keeping us away from things that will harm us. So that basic decision, whether to approach or avoid, is retreat with emotion. And it's the basis for spatial cognition.
